items:
Easy access to the beautiful turquoise waters and sugar white sandy beaches of 30A. Large 4 bedroom, 4 bath home with large Tower Room and 5 covered decks, 3rd floor has Big Views of the Gulf of Mexico, just an absolutely amazing location, convenient to everything!

Dune Allen Beach has 5 public beach access points all within walking distance.

Nestled beside Santa Rosa Beach Country Club/golf course, Oyster Lake, and the Gulf of Mexico this Charming Florida style beach house has 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms with three living areas. Fully equipped kitchen.

1 king size master bedroom on second floor with 4 piece en suite bathroom w/large jetted bathtub, and walk in shower.

3 queen size bedrooms, two are on the second floor and one in the tower suite.

2nd floor queen bedrooms share their own hall bathroom.

1 queen bedroom on third floor w/private en suite bathroom with nice private sitting area and big views of the Gulf of Mexico.

Home has easy walkable beach access and great area restaurants. Walk to Shunk Gulley to grab a bite or dip your toes in the gulf. We recommend watching the sunset from the third floor deck or sitting room; it's absolutely stunning. Lots of parking, big yard, and out door shower, community pool, bike path to the beach, beach chairs, umbrellas, cooler, beach towels, beach cart/wagon.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located in Dune Allen Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near theme parks and near the beach. While the natural beauty of Santa Rosa Beach and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.
